narrative.overview: User-pinned chess review workbench: board left, coach and notation right; mobile stack. Independent sage and charcoal identity.

rules.body: Selecting a move updates board, evaluation, coach and best-move arrow together. The amber SVG arrow overlays the board without intercepting pointer input and follows board orientation.
rules.name: Position context

dos: Honor reduced motion and keyboard navigation.
donts: Never populate fake evaluations or imply Chess.com score compatibility.
